name: 01_hello_oga
source:
ugg The first program every cave coder writes.
oga "Ooga booga! Hello cave!"
oga "Me name CMC. Me happy."

name: 02_boxes_grunk
source:
ugg Boxes remember things.
grunk name = "Ugg"
grunk rocks = 3

oga name, "has", rocks, "rocks"

rocks = rocks + 1
oga "Now", name, "has", rocks, "rocks"

grunk favorite = "big shiny rock"
oga name + "'s favorite is " + favorite

name: 03_squish_numbers
source:
ugg Numbers and math helpers.
grunk a = 7
grunk b = 2

oga "a + b =", a + b
oga "a - b =", a - b
oga "a * b =", a * b
oga "a / b =", a / b
oga "a % b =", a % b

oga "big:", big(a, b)
oga "small:", small(a, b)
oga "rounded:", round(3.7)
oga "flat:", flat(3.7)
oga "roof:", roof(3.2)
oga "abs:", abs(0 - 9)
oga "root of 81:", root(81)
oga "2 to the 3:", pow(2, 3)

name: 04_binga_if
source:
ugg binga asks a yes-or-no question.
grunk rocks = 5

binga rocks > 3
    oga "That is a lot of rocks!"
unga

binga rocks == 5
    oga "Exactly five rocks."
unga

binga rocks < 3
    oga "Not many rocks."
unga

oga "The check is done."

name: 05_wonga_else
source:
ugg wonga is what to do when the check is not gronk.
grunk door = "open"

binga door == "open"
    oga "Walk right in!"
wonga
    oga "Knock first."
unga

grunk age = 7
binga age > 10
    oga "Big kid!"
wonga binga age > 5
    oga "Medium kid!"
wonga
    oga "Small kid!"
unga

name: 06_booga_repeat
source:
ugg booga does things many times.
booga 3
    oga "BOOGA!"
unga

grunk n = 1
booga 4
    oga "lap number", n
    n = n + 1
unga

ugg The magic box 'lap' knows which lap you are on.
booga 2
    oga "this is lap", lap
unga

booga 2 + 3
    oga "five laps!"
unga

name: 07_zug_while
source:
ugg zug keeps going while the check stays gronk.
grunk fuel = 3

zug fuel > 0
    oga "Zoom! fuel left:", fuel
    fuel = fuel - 1
unga

oga "Out of fuel."

grunk count = 0
zug count < 5
    count = count + 1
unga
oga "Counted to", count

name: 08_zoop_each
source:
ugg zoop walks through a pile one thing at a time.
grunk pets = snorf("dog", "cat", "rock")

zoop pet in pets
    oga "I love my", pet
unga

ugg Text is a pile of letters too.
grunk word = "cave"
zoop letter in word
    oga "letter:", letter
unga

name: 09_clump_functions
source:
ugg clump makes your own words.
clump greet(name)
    oga "Hello " + name + "!"
unga

clump cheer()
    oga "BOOGA BOOGA BOOGA"
unga

greet("Ugg")
greet("Oona")
cheer()

name: 10_ork_return
source:
ugg ork gives an answer back from a clump.
clump add(a, b)
    ork a + b
unga

clump double(n)
    ork n * 2
unga

clump shout_name(name)
    ork shout(name) + "!"
unga

oga add(2, 3)
oga double(add(1, 4))
oga shout_name("ugg")

name: 11_piles_snorf
source:
ugg Piles hold lots of things in order.
grunk bag = snorf()
plop(bag, "apple")
plop(bag, "rock")
plop(bag, "banana")

oga bag
oga "how many:", nom(bag)
oga "first:", skoop(bag, 0)
oga "last:", bag[-1]

grunk taken = yoink(bag)
oga "I yoinked", taken
oga bag

bag[0] = "golden apple"
oga bag

name: 12_text_goop
source:
ugg Text helpers: goop, shout, whisper, flip, split, join, what.
grunk rocks = 7

oga "I am " + goop(rocks) + " years old"
oga shout("ugg")
oga whisper("VERY LOUD")
oga flip("booga")
oga "length of cave:", nom("cave")
oga "find man in caveman:", find("caveman", "man")
oga "find z in caveman:", find("caveman", "z")
oga split("rock,paper,scissors", ",")
oga join(snorf(1, 2, 3), " -> ")
oga what(3), what("hi"), what(gronk), what(plop)

name: 13_blorp_ask
source:
ugg blorp asks the person a question.
grunk name = blorp "What is your name?"
grunk color = blorp "What is your favorite color?"

oga "Hello " + name + "!"
oga color + " is a great color."

name: 14_random_munga
source:
ugg munga makes magic random numbers.
ugg munga(1, 1) is always 1, so this example gives the same answer every time.
grunk dice = munga(1, 1)
oga "The test dice rolled", dice

grunk low = munga(5, 5)
grunk high = munga(9, 9)
oga "low:", low, "high:", high

ugg Ask for a different range to make it random for real!

name: 15_fizzbuzz
source:
ugg FizzBuzz, the famous cave test.
booga 15
    binga lap % 15 == 0
        oga "fizzbuzz"
    wonga binga lap % 3 == 0
        oga "fizz"
    wonga binga lap % 5 == 0
        oga "buzz"
    wonga
        oga lap
    unga
unga

name: 16_guess_number
source:
ugg no-check -- this is a game for a real person to play!
grunk secret = munga(1, 10)
grunk tries = 0
grunk guess = 0

oga "I am thinking of a number from 1 to 10!"

zug guess != secret
    grunk answer = blorp "Your guess?"
    guess = numba(answer)
    tries = tries + 1
    binga guess < secret
        oga "Bigger!"
    wonga binga guess > secret
        oga "Smaller!"
    unga
unga

oga "Yes! You got it in", tries, "tries."

name: 17_drawing_skrib
source:
ugg skrib draws on the picture window (the Draw tab in OGABOOGA CODER).
skrib size 400, 400
skrib color "orange"
skrib circle 200, 200, 100
skrib color "black"
skrib dot 200, 200, 10
skrib line 0, 0, 400, 400
skrib box 20, 20, 60, 60
skrib blob 320, 320, 50, 50
skrib write "SUN!", 175, 320
oga "Picture done!"

name: 18_countdown
source:
ugg Count down and blast off.
grunk n = 5
zug n > 0
    oga n
    n = n - 1
unga
oga "Blast off!"

name: 19_stars_triangle
source:
ugg A triangle of stars using a loop inside a loop.
grunk n = 1
zug n <= 5
    grunk stars = ""
    booga n
        stars = stars + "*"
    unga
    oga stars
    n = n + 1
unga

name: 20_grade_calc
source:
ugg Grades and clumps that give back answers.
grunk score = 87

binga score >= 90
    oga "Grade: A"
wonga binga score >= 80
    oga "Grade: B"
wonga binga score >= 70
    oga "Grade: C"
wonga
    oga "Grade: Try again tomorrow"
unga

clump grade(score)
    binga score >= 90
        ork "A"
    wonga
        ork "not A"
    unga
unga

oga "Function says:", grade(95)

name: 21_list_stats
source:
ugg Add up a pile and find the biggest thing in it.
grunk numbers = snorf(4, 8, 15, 16, 23, 42)

grunk total = 0
zoop n in numbers
    total = total + n
unga

oga "How many:", nom(numbers)
oga "Total:", total
oga "Average:", total / nom(numbers)

grunk biggest = numbers[0]
zoop n in numbers
    binga n > biggest
        biggest = n
    unga
unga
oga "Biggest:", biggest

name: 22_reverse_text
source:
ugg Turn text around, letter by letter.
clump reverse(text)
    grunk out = ""
    grunk i = nom(text) - 1
    zug i >= 0
        out = out + skoop(text, i)
        i = i - 1
    unga
    ork out
unga

oga reverse("caveman")
oga reverse("booga")
oga flip("oga")

name: 23_times_table
source:
ugg A little times table made of piles.
grunk row = 1
zug row <= 3
    grunk parts = snorf()
    booga 3
        plop(parts, row * lap)
    unga
    oga join(parts, " ")
    row = row + 1
unga

name: 24_hot_potato
source:
ugg no-check -- random means the answer changes every run!
grunk players = snorf("Ugg", "Oona", "Grog", "Zug")
grunk rock = munga(0, nom(players) - 1)

oga "Pass the rock around the circle..."
oga "The rock stops with", players[rock] + "!"
oga "Run it again for a different friend."

name: 25_rock_paper_scissors
source:
ugg no-check -- a game for a real person!
grunk choices = snorf("rock", "paper", "scissors")

oga "Rock, paper, scissors!"
grunk mine = whisper(blorp "Your throw?")
grunk theirs = choices[munga(0, 2)]

oga "You threw", mine
oga "CMC threw", theirs

binga mine == theirs
    oga "Tie! Throw again."
wonga binga mine == "rock" and theirs == "scissors"
    oga "You win!"
wonga binga mine == "paper" and theirs == "rock"
    oga "You win!"
wonga binga mine == "scissors" and theirs == "paper"
    oga "You win!"
wonga binga mine == "rock" or mine == "paper" or mine == "scissors"
    oga "CMC wins! Try again."
wonga
    oga "That is not a real throw. Try rock, paper, or scissors."
unga

name: 26_fibonacci
source:
ugg A clump that calls itself: the famous Fibonacci numbers.
clump fib(n)
    binga n < 2
        ork n
    unga
    ork fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)
unga

booga 10
    oga "fib", lap, "=", fib(lap - 1)
unga

name: 27_turtle_spiral
source:
ugg Draw a spiral with a loop.
skrib size 400, 400
skrib color "purple"

grunk x = 200
grunk y = 20

booga 30
    grunk nx = x + 4 * lap
    grunk ny = y + 12
    skrib line x, y, nx, ny
    x = nx
    y = ny
    binga y > 390
        y = 20
    unga
unga

oga "Spiral done!"

name: 28_word_counter
source:
ugg Count the words in a sentence.
grunk sentence = "the cave man made a big fire"
grunk words = split(sentence, " ")
grunk long_words = 0

zoop word in words
    binga nom(word) > 3
        long_words = long_words + 1
    unga
unga

oga "Words:", nom(words)
oga "Long words:", long_words

name: 29_temperature
source:
ugg Temperature clumps: math with a purpose.
clump to_f(c)
    ork c * 9 / 5 + 32
unga

clump to_c(f)
    ork (f - 32) * 5 / 9
unga

oga "0C is", to_f(0), "F"
oga "100C is", to_f(100), "F"
oga "212F is", to_c(212), "C"
oga "98.6F is", round(to_c(98.6)), "C"

name: 30_cave_painting
source:
ugg Paint a tiny cave scene.
skrib size 500, 400
skrib color "skyblue"
skrib blob 0, 0, 500, 300
skrib color "gold"
skrib dot 400, 80, 40
skrib color "green"
skrib blob 0, 300, 500, 100
skrib color "brown"
skrib blob 150, 200, 120, 130
skrib color "black"
skrib write "the first cave painting", 30, 370
oga "Cave painting drawn!"

name: 31_english_aliases
source:
ugg You can also write CMC with English words.
let x = 5
if x > 3
    print "x is big"
else
    print "x is small"
end

repeat 2
    print "again"
end

function double(n)
    return n * 2
end

print double(4)
print true, false, nothing
